rules: Domestic gross output counts intermediate production; GDP/GVA subtracts domestic and imported intermediate inputs. Imports of capital enter investment and imports once; depreciation is subtracted only for net product.
Growth is domestic capital formation and increases future maintenance, resources and funding needs; it is not external revenue.
The prior 100 kg/resident export-factory constraint and customer-budget ceilings are absent from capacity calculations. Prices, demand and qualification remain independent gates.
The same spare capacity cannot simultaneously support maximum exports, replacement and maximum growth.

Component partitions and extended structural lives are design comparisons; imported active modules retain their original lives. Price-density sensitivity prevents mass localization from being treated as a guaranteed equal percentage of value localization.
Local fabrication consumes metal, alloy imports, energy, machine capacity and delivery of recovered stock. Pressure-composite production and advanced semiconductor production remain imported.
The 2.5% crater site quota is the eventual programme ceiling. Its architectural population is not a demographic target. The initial vacuum quota and uncounted lava-tube quota remain separate.
No scenario establishes permitted source reserves or a terraforming date. No indefinite exponential growth or free autonomous self-reproduction is assumed.

Trace nutrients require element-specific assays; no aggregate trace-metal sales value is assigned.

proportional_rightsizing_bound.status: Continuous proportional-sizing bound only. Discrete fleets, ten-station power redundancy and safe retirement require separate design; retaining the construction system for growth is evaluated explicitly above.

initial_capital_context.status: Preserved space-fuel/local-tug procurement scenario, with its original campaign and replacement assumptions. The new annual modular cases do not silently rerate this sunk campaign; a new initial deployment design must solve the bootstrap and commissioning sequence.

independent_anchors.rule: Proposed normalization from destination-service prices, with a scoped original pressure-procurement cross-check. The manufacturing basket assumes a common Earth-delivery scope that the previous U quote did not establish, and is not an independent calibration. No market exchange rate, peg or universal relative-price consistency is established; rescaling units cannot finance a deficit.

currency.rule: A bookkeeping normalization, purchasing-power comparisons and a market exchange rate are distinct. Domestic production cannot settle USD invoices by choosing a different conversion. Capital recovery or sales per U of capital is a yield, not an exchange rate. A sustainable peg requires funded trade, convertibility and reserve policy; none is fixed here.

limits: Diameters are catalogue parameters; no uniform measurement accuracy or error propagation is claimed.
Missing diameters remain unknown; no albedo-based diameter is silently substituted.
A uniform density and spherical volume give scenario masses, not measured masses.
Darkness and this orbit filter establish neither water grade nor the assumed transport delta-v.
Excluded names illustrate science/heritage screening; all other bodies remain unapproved.
Known-body stock is incomplete and is not a million-year population forecast; dynamical replenishment must not be treated as an inexhaustible local reserve.

resource_horizon.rule: No permitted accessible reserve has been proved. Joint products improve useful recovery but do not restore discharged propellant or eliminate feed. Growth paths include cumulative feed; exhaustion dates require permitted recoverable reserves and route-qualified sources, and local Earth-Moon/near-Earth industry has no demonstrated million-year entitlement.
